scope: Real current-user refresh/global logout; existing controlled accounts only; no password, profile or role change

checks.name: Two independent A sessions and distinct B identity authenticated
Managed A renewal returns same identity
Actual global logout accepted and initiating session cleared
Other A refresh rejected by hosted Auth after global logout
B remains authenticated and renews after A global logout

limit: Existing signed access JWTs may remain valid until expiry per managed Auth design; this test proves refresh revocation, not immediate access-JWT invalidation.
